query: What is the procedure for contacting the Anti-Counterfeiting Currency Wing within the Tamil Nadu Police force?
reference_answer:
Contacting Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing:
To contact the Anti-Counterfeit Currency Wing in Tamil Nadu Police, you can visit the Tamil Nadu Police website or call the police helpline number (103 or 044-28448000). You can also report cases at your local police station.
answer: To contact the Anti-Counterfeiting Currency Wing in the Tamil Nadu Police force, one should visit their official website or call the police station directly. [Document 1]
